audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose never names a Mel ability and gives no sequencing; the full-layer level chart reads "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Mel/Mel.
audit.why: Karma's early is genuinely dominant (Mantra online at level 1, Q 950 range vs Mel's 950 Radiant Volley on a longer 10s cooldown), and Mel takes over once Golden Eclipse (120/100/80, global) plus items cash Overwhelm stacks. The two layers must agree.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma, phases[4] stays Skill, phases[5..6] to Mel, matching win[0..6] already on disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text is generic and the late rows describe Karma winning while the chart hands those rows to Mel.
audit.why: Mel's spike is Golden Eclipse at 6 plus first item: Overwhelm stacks infinitely and R strikes at 25000 range, so her power is a stored resource, not a lane trade.
audit.corrected: Late-phase whys rewritten around Overwhelm accumulation and the global R.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no digit; Rebuttal is described only as "reflects your projectiles" with no cooldown; Solar Snare, Radiant Volley, Searing Brilliance and Golden Eclipse are never named anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Karma's Q is projectile-flagged and Rebuttal (W) reflects projectiles and blanks damage on a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown — the single decisive interaction. Karma's W tether is a targeted link, not a projectile, so it is the tool that still works. Solar Snare (E) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is Mel's only lockdown.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and the Do's/Don'ts bodies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentions the Overwhelm execute threshold or that Mel's passive adds up to nine bonus projectiles on her next attack after any cast.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's text for Searing Brilliance and change when it is safe to stand at a given HP.
